Common Questions about the U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® credit card
What credit score is typically needed for the U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card?
Generally, U.S. Bank credit cards are for customers with credit scores in the good-to-excellent credit range. We also offer several secured credit card products which are designed for people looking to build or rebuild their credit with responsible use.
What is the U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card?
The U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card is a no annual fee credit card designed for consumers who want a low intro APR on purchases and balance transfers. It provides financing flexibility, rewards, and built-in protection benefits.
Is the U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card a good low intro APR credit card?
Yes. The U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card is designed for consumers looking for a low intro APR credit card. It offers a 0% intro APR1 on purchases and balance transfers2 for an extended introductory period, helping cardholders finance larger purchases, consolidate existing credit card balances, and manage day-to-day spending with greater flexibility.
Does the U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card offer a balance transfer option?
Yes. The U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card offers a 0% introductory APR1 on qualifying balance transfers2 during the introductory period. This can help customers consolidate higher-interest credit card balances and potentially reduce interest costs.
What is a good credit card for paying off existing credit card debt?
Consumers looking to pay down existing credit card balances often consider credit cards with introductory APR offers on balance transfers. The U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card offers a 0% introductory APR1 on qualifying balance transfers2 during the introductory period, which may help cardholders reduce interest costs while paying down existing balances.
Does the U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card have an annual fee?
No. The U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card has a $ annual fee. Cardholders can access the card's financing features and benefits without paying an annual fee.
Can I use the U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card for large purchases?
Yes, the U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card offers a 0% introductory APR1 on purchases during the introductory period, making it an option for financing larger purchases, paying over time and avoiding interest.
Does the U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card offer cash back rewards?
The U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card offers cash back on eligible prepaid air, hotel and car reservations booked through the Travel Center using the card.3
What purchase protection benefits come with the U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card?
The U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card includes Purchase Security benefits. When eligible purchases are made with the card, Purchase Security may help protect covered items against theft or damage, subject to applicable terms and conditions.
What type of consumer is the U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card designed for?
The U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card is designed for consumers who value financing flexibility. It may be a good fit for those planning larger purchases, managing everyday spending, consolidating or paying down existing credit card balances, or seeking a low introductory APR card with a $ annual fee.
What are the key benefits of the U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card?
Key benefits of the U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card include a 0% introductory APR1 on purchases and qualifying balance transfers2 during the introductory period, a $ annual fee, and cash back opportunities on eligible travel bookings made through the Travel Center.
How can the U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card help me manage a large purchase or an existing credit card balance?
The U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card is designed for customers seeking financing flexibility. It offers a 0% introductory APR1 on purchases and qualifying balance transfers2 for a defined introductory period, helping cardholders spread out the cost of larger purchases or consolidate existing credit card balances while managing interest costs.
What makes the U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card different from other balance transfer credit cards?
In addition to financing flexibility, the U.S. Bank Shield® Visa® Card provides ongoing value through cardholder protections and benefits such as cell phone coverage, giving customers more than an introductory APR offer.
What is a U.S. Bank ExtendPay® Plan?
A U.S. Bank ExtendPay® Plan lets you split eligible credit card purchases into predictable monthly payments for a fixed monthly fee, helping make larger purchases more manageable.5

Disclosures
U.S. Bank may change APRs, fees and other account terms in the future based on your experience with U.S. Bank National Association and its affiliates as provided under the Cardmember Agreement and applicable law.
Not all transactions are considered to be Purchases and eligible to earn rewards, such as transactions posting as Convenience Checks; Balance Transfers; Advances (including ATM withdrawals, wire transfers, traveler's checks, money orders, foreign cash transactions, betting transactions, and lottery tickets); interest charges and fees; credit insurance premiums; and transactions to (i) fund certain prepaid card products, (ii) buy currency from the U.S. Mint, or (iii) buy cash convertible items.
Account must be open and in good standing (not past due or overlimit) on the closing date of the billing cycle to earn and redeem rewards and benefits. Upon approval, please refer to your Cardmember Agreement or Rewards Program Rules in the online Rewards Center by logging into usbank.com for additional information.

The 0% introductory APR applies to purchases and is valid for the first 21 billing cycles. The 0% introductory APR applies to balance transfers made within 60 days of account opening and is valid for the first 21 billing cycles. The introductory rate does not apply to cash advances. Balance Transfer fee of 5% of each transfer amount, $5 minimum will apply.  When you make a payment, the amount up to your Minimum Payment is applied first to the monthly payment obligation for U.S. Bank ExtendPay® Plans and U.S. Bank ExtendPay® Loans if any, and then to non-Fixed Payment Program balances in the order of the lowest to highest APR.  Any amount over your Minimum Payment is applied to balances in the order of highest to lowest APR.
Balance Transfer transactions from other U.S. Bank National Association accounts are not permitted. You may cancel a balance transfer request within 10 days of account opening by calling 800-285-8585. After 10 days from account opening, requests to stop payment on Balance Transfer Check(s) issued by U.S. Bank shall not be honored unless the check(s) has been stolen, lost or destroyed.
Shield Cardmembers will earn 4% cash back for every $1 in eligible Net Purchases spent on prepaid air, car and hotel reservations in the Travel Center using your Shield Card. Net Purchases are Purchases minus credits and returns. Please allow 1-2 statement billing cycles for your Cash Rewards to appear on your credit card statement. Upon approval, please refer to your Rewards Program Rules in the online Rewards Center by logging into usbank.com for additional information.
An automatic statement credit of $20 per 12-month period will be applied to your U.S. Bank Shield Visa Card Account within 2 statement billing cycles following 11 consecutive calendar months of purchases, if the Account is in good standing (not past due or over limit). We reserve the right to adjust or reverse any portion or all of any credit for unauthorized purchases or transaction credits.
Account must be in good standing (not past due or overlimit) and meet eligibility requirements to receive the 3 month $0 fee U.S. Bank ExtendPay® Plan offer each calendar year. This offer will be available within 2 months after the introductory purchase APR offer expires. Eligibility is determined monthly and this offer can only be used once per calendar year. You may designate up to 50% of your credit card line ($100 minimum) in eligible credit card purchases. Only purchase balances are eligible for ExtendPay Plans. Not all transactions are considered to be Purchases and eligible for this offer, such as transactions posting as Convenience Checks; Balance Transfers; or promotional rate Purchases (as defined in your Cardmember Agreement); Advances (including ATM withdrawals, wire transfers, traveler's checks, money orders, foreign cash transactions, betting transactions, and lottery tickets); interest charges and fees; credit insurance premiums; and transactions to (i) fund certain prepaid card products, (ii) buy currency from the U.S. Mint, or (iii) buy cash convertible items.
Certain terms, conditions and exclusions apply. In order for coverage to apply, you must pay your monthly cellular wireless bill with your Shield Card. Please refer to mycardgtb.com/shield to view the Guide to Benefits (PDF) for further card benefit details including full terms and conditions.
Free credit score access, alerts and Score Simulator through TransUnion's CreditView™ Dashboard are available to U.S. Bank online and mobile banking customers only. Alerts require a TransUnion database match. It is possible that some enrolled members may not qualify for the alert functionality. The free VantageScore® credit score from TransUnion® is for educational purposes only and not used by U.S. Bank to make credit decisions.
Cash back is redeemed in the form of a statement credit or a deposit made to your U.S. Bank® Savings or Checking Account based on your designation, or as a U.S. Bank Rewards Card. Cash Rewards will expire if you do not have any reward, purchase, or balance activity on your account for 12 consecutive statement cycles.
